items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: I think that was the band at the time with Paul.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, yeah, I don't even remember who was in the band exactly. But you were talking about Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Pearson, reminded me.
Right. And I think they were, I think that was the band at the time with Paul.
Yeah. Because Paul Balburn, I believe, held his audition. I was trying to.
